title: Beef Birria Chinese Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional Chinese and Mexican dishes. This recipe combines the tender beef of birria with the flavors and textures of Chinese cuisine.
instructions: In a large pan or wok, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the beef and cook until browned, then add the soy sauce, brown sugar, and beef broth.
Simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Shred the beef with two forks and stir in the oozey cheese.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto the tortillas and serving immediately.
Garnish with additional oozey cheese and serve with your favorite toppings.
